subject: Scheduling: Dedicated capacity sizing call for Acme Retail - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up + scheduling dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the great discussion this morning. Quick recap from my side: Acme's priority is to serve personalized product recommendations and search re-ranking with strict latency targets during peak shopping windows. You mentioned wanting predictable per-token costs and capacity isolation, which is exactly what Redwood Dedicated is designed for.

Next step: schedule a dedicated capacity sizing call (technical deep dive) where our Pre-Sales engineer (Camila) and infra lead (Dylan) will run through throughput assumptions, typical request payloads, and target SLOs so we can size a committed GPU pool and propose an initial config.

Can you confirm who from your side should attend (ML infra, SRE, product)? I’ve attached a one-page capacity_sizing_template.xlsx to make it easy to share your current traffic profile.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue 2/23, 10:00–10:45
- Wed 2/24, 13:00–13:45
- Thu 2/25, 09:00–09:45

If none of those work, please let me know 2–3 preferred times and I’ll set up a meeting.

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: capacity_sizing_template.xlsx
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@acme-retail.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + scheduling dedicated capacity sizing call

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and for sending the template. Sara (ML infra) and I will join. A few preliminary numbers to help you prepare:
- Model family: 33B Llama2 variant (quantized) for ranking; may test a smaller 13B variant for some routes.
- Average QPS: ~120 requests/sec during business hours
- Peak QPS: ~850 requests/sec during promotional spikes (peaks last ~10–20 minutes)
- Typical tokens per request: 80–150 (median ~110)
- Concurrency target for p95 latency: support 100 concurrent inferences with p95 <= 350ms
- Streaming: not required for ranking; batch inference preferred if it helps throughput/cost

We prefer Wed 2/24 at 13:00 PST if that slot is still available. I’ll upload the filled template shortly.

Thanks,
Tom
Director of ML Infrastructure | Acme Retail
Tom.Reynolds@acme-retail.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@acme-retail.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T11:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + scheduling dedicated capacity sizing call

Perfect — Wed 2/24, 13:00 PST is confirmed. I’ve booked a 45-minute slot and added a Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/abc-defg-hij (calendar invite sent).

Agenda (45m):
1) Quick intro + goals (5m)
2) Review filled capacity_sizing_template and key traffic patterns (10m)
3) Technical sizing: concurrency, batching, KV-cache strategy, expected p95 targets (20m)
4) Next steps: quote, recommended Dedicated pool config, timeline (10m)

Camila — can you bring typical benchmark numbers (tokens/sec per GPU for 13B/33B variants with our quantization profiles) and also share any constraints we should be aware of for network/firewall that might affect throughput?

Tom/Sara — please upload the filled template and 1–2 representative request payloads to this folder before EOD Mon: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-sample-payloads. That will help Camila run a quick pre-call sizing exercise.

I’ve attached a short SLO_and_requirements.docx that outlines the data we typically use when sizing Dedicated pools.

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: SLO_and_requirements.docx
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@acme-retail.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T15:24:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up + scheduling dedicated capacity sizing call

Thanks Marissa — I’ll prepare per-GPU throughput estimates for our common quant profiles (13B/33B) and a couple of example batching strategies.

Quick asks for Tom/Sara before the call:
- Can you share 2 representative request payloads (JSON) and one sample batch we’d expect during peak?
- Any constraints on outbound connections from your VPC (we sometimes need to validate firewall/NAT throughput for telemetry)?
- Confirm whether you plan to use dedicated cache nodes or rely on in-GPU KV cache.

If you can upload those to the Drive link Marissa shared by EOD Mon that’ll let me run a short simulation and come with an initial sizing recommendation.

See you on Wed — I’ll bring benchmark slides + a sizing worksheet we can edit live.

Cheers,
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com
